In a regular heptagon, each interior angle measures

\[
\frac{(7-2)180^\circ}{7}=\frac{900^\circ}{7}.
\]

At vertex \(A\), the angle between heptagon sides \(AB\) and \(AD\) is therefore

\[
\angle BAD=\frac{900^\circ}{7}.
\]

Since \(AC\) is a side of the square sharing vertex \(A\) with side \(AD\),

\[
\angle CAD=90^\circ.
\]

From the diagram, \(AC\) lies inside \(\angle BAD\), so

\[
\angle BAC=\angle BAD-\angle CAD
=\frac{900^\circ}{7}-90^\circ
=\frac{900^\circ-630^\circ}{7}
=\frac{270^\circ}{7}.
\]

The answer is \(\frac{270}{7}\).
